name: LFAN Modder
text: You're always tinkering with your LFAN, making sure that it's in good repair and experimenting with methods to grant it new functionality. You can retrain all feats with the LFAN trait as a part of your daily preparations. You can use the Implant Augmentation downtime activity even if you don't meet the prerequisites. If you're an expert in Crafting or Medicine, you can Implant Augmentation in 10 minutes per item level of the augmentation. If you're a master in Crafting or Medicine, you can Implant Augmentation in 1 minute per item level.

name: Lie to Me
text: You can detect lies through subtle cues. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to disbelieve deception and to Sense Motive checks to determine if someone is lying.

name: Life Bond
text: You can speak with animals and plants. Any living creature you summon is considered part of your bond and doesn't count against the maximum number of creatures in your bond. During your daily preparations, choose one of the following spells: summon animal, summon elemental, summon fey, or summon plant or fungus. You add the selected spell to your spell repertoire and signature spells until your next daily preparations.

name: Life Bond

During your daily preparations, choose one of the following spells: , , , or . You add the selected spell to your spell repertoire and signature spells until your next daily preparations.

name: Life of the Party
text: You can make it into any party, no matter how prestigious, and once there, it's easy for you to make new friends. Any time you encounter a social event you would ordinarily be denied access to, such as a coronation, royal gala, or other society function, you can spend 1d4 hours to secure entry without the need for a skill check. You find invitations, invitees looking for fashionable dates, temporary jobs with the caterers, event staff willing to look the other way, or some other mode of access for yourself and your allies. This ability doesn't apply to secret events or other small private gatherings with no staff, dates, or outsiders involved. While at a party, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus on Diplomacy checks to Make an Impression, and this increases to a +2 circumstance bonus if you're the one throwing the party.

name: Life Preserver
text: An innate wellspring of protective magic guards you from unexpected environmental danger. You can cast once per day as a 3rd-rank primal innate spell. You can target only yourself, but the duration increases to 10 minutes.

name: Life-Giving Light
text: Frequency twice per day You suffuse your natural glow with healing light. You regain Hit Points equal to your level (]). All allies within the light of your solar luminance gain temporary Hit Points equal to half your level for 1 minute.

name: Lifelike
text: You appear not as an android, but a traditional organic creature. You become trained in Deception and gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to Impersonate living creatures as your biotech changes your body's shape or texture as part of the disguise. Creatures recognize you as a Biotech Android only if they succeed at a Perception check against your Deception DC, and you don't have to attempt a Deception check to interact with someone to conceal the fact that you're a biotech android; a check happens only if someone else tries to uncover your heritage.

name: Light 'Em Up
text: Requirements You're wielding an area or automatic weapon. Your opponents can run, but they can't hide! You spray your weapon in the general direction of an unseen enemy, revealing its location. You Area Fire or Auto-Fire. If the primary target is Concealed, you don't need to attempt a flat check to target it, and if it's Hidden, the DC of the flat check to target it is 5. When you Suppress a concealed creature with this attack, the debris around it helps reveal its current position, and no flat check is needed to target it; If it's hidden, the DC of the flat check to target it becomes 5, and the creature can't become undetected. This benefit lasts as long as the creature remains suppressed.

name: Lightning Reflexes
text: Your reflexes are second to none. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Reflex saves.

name: Lignifying Bite
text: You can transform those you lay low into wood. When a creature made of flesh and that doesn't have an active regeneration or similar ability is reduced to 0 Hit Points by your jaws Strike, you can choose to force the creature to attempt a Fortitude save against the higher of your class DC and spell DC. If it fails, it dies, and its flesh, made of earth in a metaphysical sense, transforms to wood. The wood is living and might grow into a tree over time, but it can't be used as a body or piece of a body for Raise Dead or other magic that requires a part of the body to return the creature to life.

name: Liminal Hyperlink
text: You gain the liminal hyperlink magic hack.

name: Line 'em Up
text: Requirements You're wielding a gun. You fire a single trick shot that passes through multiple foes. Make a ranged Strike with your gun against a target within your first range increment. Apply this attack against all creatures in a straight line between you and your target. This attack ignores any lesser cover the targets would provide one another. Roll damage only once, and apply it to each creature you hit. Line 'Em Up counts as two attacks for your multiple attack penalty.

Apply this attack against all creatures in a straight line between you and your target. This attack ignores any lesser cover the targets would provide one another. Roll damage only once, and apply it to each creature you hit. Line 'Em Up counts as two attacks for your multiple attack penalty.

name: Lingua Franca
text: Thanks to the linguistic properties of your runic scales and edicts, you can form an interest bridge between languages, allowing you to speak with and understand pretty much anyone. You can speak and understand all spoken languages.

name: Linguistic Master
text: Your mastery of language reaches supernatural levels. You can cast Truespeech as a 5th-rank occult innate spell once per day on yourself only. You gain a +1 status bonus to Diplomacy checks for the duration of the spell when speaking to creatures with whom you already shared a language before Casting the Spell.

name: Linguistic Prodigy
text: Learning new languages comes naturally to you. You gain two additional languages of your choice, chosen from among the common and uncommon languages available to you. Every time you take the Multilingual feat, you gain another new language in addition to the two you gain from that feat.

name: Linnorm Bite
text: Your ancestors swore allegiance to a linnorm long ago. Though your family is no longer bound to serve the creature, a bit of its influence remains in you, manifesting in particularly long and sharp teeth. You gain a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d6[piercing] damage. Your jaws are in the brawling group and have the finesse and unarmed traits.

name: Listen to the Stone
text: You open your mind to the whispers of the land and learn its secrets. You can cast Speak with Stones once per day as a 5th-rank primal innate spell. Additionally, you can use Nature to [[/act track skill=nature]] and [[/act seek skill=nature]] instead of Survival and Perception. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus when you use Nature to Track and Seek in an environment with natural or worked stone floors.

name: Living Battery
text:
Your body produces an overabundance of electrical energy, which you can emit as a blast of lightning or use to power technological devices. You can cast the Electric Arc cantrip as a divine innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

When you cast electric arc, you can also target batteries or tech items powered by batteries (in any combination). If you target a battery or tech item powered by a battery, that item isn't damaged. Instead, it regains 2 charges per spell rank. If the target is a tech item that needs a battery but doesn't currently have one, treat the item as if it had a battery with 2 charges per spell rank for 1 minute.

name: Living Furnace
text: Forged in a sun's flames, your body is a living furnace that releases an abundance of thermal energy. You become inured to high temperatures, and your body sheds a pleasant heat that can stave off the cold. You gain resistance 4 to fire. You and creatures within 20 feet of you treat environmental cold effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible cold becomes extreme, extreme cold becomes severe, and so on).

name: Living Submersible Mount
text: You can reshape your body to provide a safe means of undersea travel for trusted allies. When another PC rides you as a mount while you're using the Living Submersible ability, your expert coordination allows them to take three actions at the start of their turn rather than the two they normally could take while riding another PC. You still gain only two actions at the start of your turn, instead of three, as you spend one action keeping your rider safely contained within a protective foam layer on your back.

name: Load-Bearing Hero
text: Trigger You and one adjacent ally attempt a Reflex or Fortitude save against the same effect. Whether holding up a crumbling ceiling or jumping into a fireball, you interpose yourself between your ally and incoming danger. The result of your save becomes one degree worse, but the result of your ally's save becomes one degree higher.

name: Logical Paradox
text: Frequency once per day You have a particular interest in the inconsistencies of reality and the material universe that you've read about in philosophical texts. You overload a technological foe's logic processes by posing a paradoxical problem to them. The tech creature must have an Intelligence modifier of –3 or higher, and they must understand the language you speak. The creature attempts a Will saving throw against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. Any creature targeted by Logical Paradox becomes immune to it for 24 hours, no matter the result of their saving throw. Critical Success The creature's logic processes are strong enough to understand your logical paradox, and it has no effect. Success The creature become Glitching 1. Failure The creature becomes Glitching 2. Critical Failure The creature becomes glitching 2 and is also Stupefied 2 for as long as it remains glitching.

name: Long Tail
text: You've trained yourself to exploit the extra reach of your prehensile tail and can use that particular detail to your advantage. You can Interact to pick up, pass, or take items with your tail up to 5 feet further than your usual reach with your hands. You can Release items held by your tail into an adjacent square. Tailblades you wield gain the reach trait.

name: Long Whiskered
text: Your whiskers function as advanced electroreceptors, allowing you to orient yourself more easily. At the end of each round in which you're untethered, attempt a flat|dc:15. On a success, you ignore the Clumsy and Off-Guard conditions imposed by being in zero-g for 1 minute.

name: Long-Legged
text: Your sure-footed nature combines with your natural height and long legs to give you an exceptionally impressive stride. Your Speed increases by 5 feet.

name: Longrifle Reload
text: Frequency once per 10 minutes Requirements You are wielding a ranged weapon with reload 1 or greater. You've learned unique techniques for wielding ranged weapons, honed through generations of experience and passed down through traditional teachings and intensive hands-on training. Strike with a ranged weapon in your active hands and then either Interact to reload that weapon or Switch Hands. Special If you have the sniper shobhad heritage and are wielding a shobhad longrifle in your active hands while holding another weapon from the sniper weapon group in your inactive pair of hands, the frequency of this feat is instead once per round.

name: Look Alive
text: You warn your ally to move away from danger. You can use Watch Out before an ally in range attempts a Reflex save in addition to its original trigger. If you do, the circumstance bonus applies to their Reflex save against the triggering effect. When you use Watch Out and the triggering attack fails or critically fails, or your ally succeeds or critically succeeds at the saving throw, your ally can also Stride up to 10 feet as a free action.

name: Look Alive!
text: Your directive becomes a reaction. Once per round, when an ally within 60 feet would be attacked, you can use Get 'Em! or Steel Yourselves! as a reaction.

name: Loosed Psychic
text: Your psychic potential expands, encouraged by your blood. Choose one 1st-rank occult spell and one 2nd-rank occult spell. You can cast each of these spells once per day as occult innate spells.

name: Loosen Skin
text: Trigger You would take persistent bleed damage. The unique anatomy of talphis, wherein your loose skin hides your neck and extends to your elbows and knees, makes your body look much larger than it actually is and has plenty of give to resist more serious damage. When you're struck by an attack that would do persistent bleed damage, roll a flat. On a success, you steer the blow into a relatively safe part of your body, and the condition ends immediately.

name: Loping Vines
text: The vines you use to move—what others call your limbs—are extra long. Increase your land Speed and climb Speed by 5 feet.

name: Lowered Legs
text: Your legs can bend and retract to let you make ample use of odd sources of cover. You can [[/act take-cover]] as though you were Prone even while standing.

name: Lucky Improviser
text: You're a master improviser with a bit of talent at everything—even if you have no idea what you're doing. You gain the Untrained Improvisation general feat. In addition, you gain the Beginner's Luck action.

name: Lucky Like A Squox
text: Frequency Once per day Trigger You're about to roll initiative. Your quick reflexes and cautious nature combine to keep you hidden when trouble finds you. You Step. If you have cover, greater cover, or concealment after you Step, you can roll Stealth for initiative as if you were Avoiding Notice.

name: Lucky Shot
text: Frequency once per hour In the heat of combat, all the skill in the world doesn't mean anything if you don't have a little luck on your side. When you critically hit with a Strike against a target, before you roll the damage, you can choose to roll the damage dice pool twice and take the better of the two results.

name: Luminous Wings
text: Your energy wings shed bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light to the next 20 feet). You can extinguish or rekindle this light using a single action, which has the concentrate trait.

name: Lush Psychic
text: Your connection to the psychic energy of the natural world grows and anchors your abilities. You gain Cellular Stimulant and Gentle Landing as 1st-rank primal innate spells. You can cast each one of these primal innate spells once per day.

name: Machine Saboteur
text: You were created to fight other synthetic creatures. When you roll a critical hit against a creature with the tech trait, the target becomes glitching 1.

name: Mageslayer
text: As a result of generational war between your peoples, you've trained in special antimagic techniques to battle elven and lashunta spellcasters. You gain a mageslayer claw unarmed attack that deals ] damage, is in the brawling weapon group, and has the finesse, primal, and unarmed traits. A creature you Strike with your mageslayer claw must attempt a Will save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. On a failure, the creature becomes Stupefied 1 for 1 minute (or Stupefied 2 on a critical failure).

name: Magic Coagulant
text: Your blood works to assist you and even helps others who try to heal your wounded form. You can use Battle Medicine and Treat Wounds without a medkit, and your allies don't need a medkit to use Battle Medicine on you or Treat your Wounds. The first time each day, when someone rolls a failure or a critical failure on a check to use Battle Medicine on you or Treat your Wounds, the magic in your blood coagulates to assist and increases the degree of success by one step, even if you're Unconscious.

name: Magic Collate Ball
text: Your jeweled orb has a lattice to process magic that can automatically troubleshoot and correct calculations in magical formulas to prevent mishaps when using unfamiliar magic. You become trained in a skill matching the tradition of the innate spell you gained with the jeweled orb bantrid heritage. The relevant skills are Arcana for arcane, Nature for primal, Occultism for occult, or Religion for divine. If you were already trained in the relevant skill, you become trained in another one of those skills. You gain the Trick Magic Item skill feat.

name: Magic Fortification
text: With arcane blood in your veins, you can deflect the worst effects of magic. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against arcane spells and effects.

name: Magical Crafting
text: You can Craft magic items, though some have other requirements. When you select this feat, you gain formulas for four common magic items of 2nd level or lower.

name: Magical Guardian
text: Your desire to protect the people you care about from harm has kindled the spark of magic in your soul, and you can share that spark with others. You can cast the Guidance and Forbidding Ward cantrips as divine innate spells at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. Whenever you cast one of these spells on your bonded partner, you increase the range of the spell to 60 feet, rather than 30 feet.

name: Magical Savior
text: When push comes to shove, you're more than willing to give your life in place of an ally's. You gain Spirit Link as a 3rd-rank divine innate spell. You can cast this spell once per day. If you cast this spell on your bonded partner, spirit link is heightened to 4th-rank and you can increase the range of spirit link to 60 feet, rather than 30 feet.

name: Magically Melodious
text: Halfling musicians have a magical trick handed down from artist to artist, so they're always prepared for an impromptu gig. You become trained in Performance. If you would automatically become trained in Performance (from a background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. Additionally, you gain as an occult innate cantrip. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

name: Magitech Core
text: Your body incorporates a number of magical and technological components, granting you some innate magical power. You gain the Ancestral Cantrip feat from your ancestry or from the android ancestry. You're trained in the skill associated with the tradition of the cantrip you learned this way (Arcana for arcane, Religion for divine, Occultism for occult, or Nature for primal). If you would automatically become trained in that skill (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

name: Magitech Weapon Adjustment
text: You've learned to cast some simple energy manipulation spells to help get additional versatility out of your and your allies' weapons. You can cast and once per day each as 1st-rank arcane innate spells.

name: Magma Swim
text: You're more protected from magma and can swim through it like a fish, even though magma is so dense that most creatures couldn't. You gain a swim Speed equal to your land Speed, which you can only use to swim through magma or molten lava. Your resistance to fire from Draconic Resistance increases to 40 + five times your level against ambient environmental damage from lava or magma (but not against any other fire damage, such as damage from lava or magma spells or abilities). This typically isn't enough to protect you completely from lava right away, but as you grow stronger and the effects of the lux aeterna ritual increase your magic flow, this eventually grants you so much resistance that lava and magma rarely harm you any more.

name: Magma Tomb
text:
Frequency once per day

You spit a molten boulder at a target within 120 feet. This deals 8d6 fire damage and 3d12 bludgeoning damage, with a basic Reflex save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. If the creature fails its save, it's encased in magma that instantly cools and has Hardness 10, HP 40, and BT 20. The encased creature can't breathe and is immobilized until it Escapes, against the higher of your class DC and spell DC, or the magma breaks.

name: Magnetic Projectile
text: By quickly reversing the polarity on a portion of your magnetic foot orb, you can launch items attached to you at your enemies. You gain a magnetic projectile unarmed attack in the sling weapon group with a range increment of 30 feet that deals 1d4 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage—as appropriate for the object you hurled. You must have a metallic object of at least light Bulk attached to your foot orb as ammunition for this attack, but no specific traits or magic properties of the thrown item affect the attack or the damage.

name: Magnetic Sweeper
text: Your magnetic foot orb picks up loose metal objects that you can retrieve later. Whenever you leave a square, you can pick up one unattended object of 1 Bulk or less that is mostly made out of metal with your foot orb. Your foot orb can hold 4 Bulk of items, and the first 2 Bulk of these items don't count against your Bulk limits. These items are considered stowed and must be drawn in order to be used.

name: Major Miner
text: You pass through earth and stone almost as easily as air. It's no longer a matter of digging, but rather becoming one with the ground and allowing it to carry you to your destination. When you Burrow, you can choose whether or not you leave behind a tunnel. If you choose to leave a tunnel, creatures one size larger than you or smaller can use the hole, but creatures one size larger than you have to Squeeze. If you don't leave a tunnel, you can [[/act sneak]] while Burrowing at your full movement speed.

name: Make Them Pay
text: When your enemies have you cornered, you become ever more vicious. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that deals damage to a single target, and if that spell doesn't have a duration, you gain a circumstance bonus to its damage equal to twice the sum of your and conditions (to a maximum of +12) if you have one or both conditions.

name: Malfunction Aura
text: For one reason or another, machines around you often spontaneously break down. Whenever an enemy starts its turn adjacent to you, it must attempt a save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. On a failure, the target's wielded tech items (or the target itself if it has the tech trait) becomes Glitching 1 (Glitching 2 on a critical failure) as long as it remains adjacent to you. Regardless of the result of the save, the creature is then temporarily immune to your Malfunction Aura for 24 hours.

name: Management Material
text: You understand how organizations work from the inside. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Society checks involving corporate or political organizations and can Recall Knowledge about such groups as a free action.

name: Manifold Evolution
text: You've cataloged the genetic code from countless ancestries you've encountered, and you can draw upon any of them to enhance and evolve your body. Increase the number of ancestries you can select with Convergent Evolution to six. You gain two additional ancestry feats you qualify for of 13th level or lower, chosen from among the ancestries selected with Convergent Evolution. You can retrain one or both of these selected feats once per day during your daily preparations.

name: Manifold Masters
text: You've broadened your senses and are better able to comprehend the unseen answers all around you. When you use Student of the Unseen during your daily preparations, you gain Additional Lore twice.

name: Mantarider
text: You have trained in the ceremonial art of combat mounted upon a manta and can apply your experience to other forms of mobile combat. Reduce the penalty when attacking from a vehicle that has moved within the last round to 0 (or –2 if the vehicle is uncontrolled or any action in the last round had the reckless trait). You don't take a penalty to Reflex saves while mounted.

name: Maratan Athlete
text: To navigate the wilds of Marata, you ask more of your body than most. You become trained in Athletics. If you would automatically become trained in Athletics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. When you fall, you can [[/act grab-an-edge]] using your tail with an Athletics check instead of Acrobatics.

name: March!
text: You form up with allies and move in unison. Stride once. You can choose up to two willing allies adjacent to you at the start of your movement to move with you as a reaction. All allies end their movement adjacent to you, but not adjacent to one another, forming a line or triangle. Creatures moving with March! can't move further than the lowest Speed used by any other creature in that march.

name: March! Two Three Four
text: Whether with subtle telepathy or your natural leadership skills, you're able to link up and move with allies more efficiently. You can as a single action instead of two actions.

name: Martial Vocational Training
text: Your training with an unconventional weapon has taught you the basics of how to use that weapon for its original nonviolent purpose. While wielding a weapon with the professional trait, you become trained in one skill listed for that weapon's professional trait. If you were already trained in that skill, you become an expert instead. You also gain in that skill while wielding the weapon.

name: Mascot Power!
text: Your soulfeel has attracted and bound the spirit of a creature to you. When you select this feat, choose Summon Animal or Summon Fey. You can cast the chosen spell as a primal innate spell once per day, heightened to half your level rounded up.

name: Masked
text: Your masked face prevents others from scrutinizing your appearance, and you've learned to leverage this uncertainty to your advantage in social situations. While your mouth is covered, increase the DC of any Perception check to Sense Motive against you by 2. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Lie, make a Request, or Make an Impression.

name: Masks under Masks
text: Even if you are forced to reveal your natural appearance, you have an additional layer of security in the form of a backup shapeshifting identity. Choose one form during your daily preparations. Waving away your ability to transform as some unrelated magic or technology, you gain a +3 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to Lie that the chosen form is your true form. You can tell lies that protect your identity even against magical spells, and effects like truesight reveal the chosen form as your true form. You revert to this form if you become the target of a spell or effect that causes you to unwillingly shift back to your true form.

name: Mass Epiphany
text: Your epiphanies can touch all bonded allies simultaneously. Once per day, when you cast a connection focus spell that normally targets one creature, you may instead have it affect all bonded allies within 60 feet.

name: Mass Laughter
text:
Frequency once per day

You tell a joke so transcendentally fantastic, everyone around you starts laughing. This has the effects of Hideous Laughter for as long as you Sustain the effects, up to 1 minute, except that instead of targeting one creature within 30 feet, you instead target all creatures within 30 feet.

name: Massive Fists
text: You punch with brutal force akin to a club or rock. Your fist unarmed attacks don't have the nonlethal trait and gain the shove weapon trait.

name: Master Code Cracker
text: You can apply the original jailbreak benefits in addition to the jailbreak benefits of spells you modify with Double Jailbreak.

name: Master Hunter
text: For a maraquoi, hearing is a full-body experience. While most of your kind can use their hypersensitive hearing to track the world around them with great precision, you've taken the ability to the next level. By concentrating on the vibrations rolling across thousands of receptors on your skin, you can pick up on the slightest movement and use it to find hidden enemies. Your dermal hearing becomes a precise sense.

name: Master Mystic Spellcasting
text: You gain the Master Spellcasting benefits.

name: Master Plan
text: During your daily preparations, you can review stratagems with up to five allies. Later, you can quickly advise each of these allies on your schemes using the New Plan reaction.

name: Master Plan
text: During your daily preparations, you can review stratagems with up to five allies. Later, you can quickly advise each of these allies on your schemes using the reaction.

name: Master Spy
text: Your proficiency rank for Perception increases to master.

name: Master Witchwarper Spellcasting
text: You gain the Master Spellcasting benefits.

name: Masterful Imitation
text: You've studied certain creatures enough that you can transform into them. If you are a master in a Lore skill that can be used to identify a category of creatures, you can use Change Shape to transform your appearance to that of a Small or Medium creature of that category.

name: Maximize Profits
text: You've learned to maximize your potential earnings. Whenever you would fail an Earn Income check, you get a success instead.

name: Maze Lost
text: You constantly wander the maze of life, moving from one interest to the next; as a result, it's easy to forget past passions while delving into others. You gain the feat, as well as the benefits of for that Lore subcategory, even if you don't meet the prerequisites. You can retrain Maze Lost to a different Lore skill subcategory with 1 day of downtime.

name: Mazer's Endurance
text: Your focus is so powerful that it's easy for you to lose track of self care, but fortunately, you've trained to endure periods of stress. You're never as a result of hunger or starvation as long as you spend time during your daily preparations solving or creating a puzzle or riddle. You only need to sleep for 2 hours a day, and you need only 4 hours of rest between your daily preparations. Choose a Lore skill related to the puzzle or riddle you worked on. Until your next daily preparations, you become trained in that skill, and if you roll a critical failure on a check to with that Lore skill, you get a failure instead.

name: Meandering Mind
text: Requirements Your quantum field is active. You allow your mind to wander to things you find pleasant, briefly shutting out all realities and protecting you from harm. You gain a +2 status bonus to saving throws against mental effects until the start of your next turn.

name: Mediator
text: You're a talented diplomat or mediator who's skilled at making a good impression and accustomed to finding compromises, brokering deals, and forging strong social connections. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Diplomacy. If you would automatically become trained in Diplomacy (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks to Make an Impression.

name: Medicinal Trinket
text: Some trinkets are useful for medicinal purposes. You have found another trinket of light Bulk that can serve as a tool for certain traditional medicinal uses and can Conceal an Object of negligible Bulk inside of it. You can use your Medicinal Trinket as a medkit when you Treat Wounds. The first time each day you use the Medicinal Trinket to use Battle Medicine or Treat Wounds on yourself, you gain additional temporary Hit Points equal to your level that last for 1 hour, regardless of the result of the attempt.

name: Medicine Mastery
text: Your medical knowledge is extensive. You can treat deadly wounds as a move action and can attempt to treat diseases and poisons as if your skill level were 2 higher.

name: Meditative Analysis
text: You briefly meditate on the nature of your foe and their role in the wider cosmos. Attempt a check to Recall Knowledge about a creature. On a success, your next Strike with a solar weapon against the target this round additionally gains a +1 circumstance bonus. If your Strike hits, you can choose which attunement benefit you gain for that strike. The subject of your check is temporarily immune to Meditative Analysis for 1 day.

name: Meld With Nature
text: You can blend effortlessly into nature. You can [[/act hide]] in natural environments even without cover or concealment, and you don't become automatically observed in a natural environment if you end your [[/act sneak]] without cover or concealment.

name: Melodic Adaptation
text: You can hear the thrum of magic as if it were a swirling note, a shifting melody, a harmonic chord, or a percussive beat, pulsing in tune with your heart. You can detect the presence of magic as though you were always using a 1st-rank Detect Magic spell. This detects magic within a type:emanation|distance:30. At 13th level, the rank of detect magic increases to 3rd. At 17th level, the rank of detect magic increases to 4th.

name: Memories of Ashok
text: With unparalleled focus, you can tap into and sift through the memories of every contemplative who has come before. You can cast the Collective Memories ritual once per week as the primary caster. When you do so, you can ignore the rare incense cost; if you do so, you become Drained 2 after completing the ritual.

name: Memories of Before
text: Frequency once per day Trigger You fail a skill check or saving throw. You were alive during the Gap, but like everyone else, you remember nothing from that time. You're haunted by centuries of lost experiences that shaped you into a form you can't identify. Reroll the triggering check, but you must use the new result, even if it's worse. You become Frightened 1.

name: Memories of Valor
text: Frequency once per day While the memories of most enshrined vesk are hazy and ephemeral, with some concentration you can recall memories of your amalgamated souls vividly enough to apply your experiences. Choose one skill. You temporarily increase your proficiency rank with that skill by one step for 1 minute (from untrained to trained, trained to expert, and expert to master). This temporary increase adjusts your proficiency bonus and allows you to use skill actions based on this increased proficiency as normal. Memories of Valor can't increase a skill's proficiency rank beyond master.

name: Memory Hole
text:
Frequency once every 10 minutes

Trigger You become Frightened.
You let your memory forget the immediate past to better move beyond its trauma. Reduce your frightened value by 1.

name: Memory Matrix
text: You refuse to surrender your autonomy and have erected mental bulwarks and technological protocols to safeguard your mind and memories. Whenever you attempt a Will save against a spell or effect that would give you the Confused or Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr condition, roll that save twice and use the higher result (this is a fortune effect). name: Memory Recovery
text: You retain instincts and fragmentary memories from the androids who previously occupied your body or from ancient programming embedded in your system. During your daily preparations, you can tap into these archived memories to become trained in one skill of your choice. This proficiency lasts until you prepare again. Since this proficiency is temporary, you can't use it as a prerequisite for a skill increase or a permanent character option like a feat.

name: Memory Shield
text:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You take damage from an effect that deals vitality damage.
You draw upon precious memories from your life to shield you against the energies that would nominally purge undead creatures from the universe. You gain resistance to the triggering damage equal to your level.

name: Menacing Growl
text: Requirements A creature within 30 feet has the frightened condition. You snarl ferociously at a creature within 30 feet, menacing them with bared teeth. Increase the value of the frightened condition by 1 (maximum 3). The target then becomes temporarily immune to your Menacing Snarl for 24 hours. As long as the target is frightened, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to melee Strikes against that creature, and damage dealt to the creature by your melee Strikes deals an additional ] damage per damage die.

name: Menacing Huff
text: Your stature cuts a threatening figure, such that even a forceful breath can feel like a threat to smaller beings. You become trained in Intimidation. If you're already trained in Intimidation (from your background or class, for example), you become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the skill feat. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to [[/act demoralize]] targets that are smaller than you.

name: Menacing Laughter

When a foe Casts a Spell that has the mental trait and you can see or otherwise detect its manifestations, you use your psychic powers to disrupt it. You expend 1 Focus Point to counter the triggering creature's casting of the spell. You then attempt to counteract the triggering spell using your spellcasting attribute modifier plus your spellcasting proficiency bonus as your counteract modifier and half your level, rounded up, as your counteract rank.

name: Mental Fortress
text: Your disciplined mind resists intrusion. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against mental effects, and you can attempt a new save at the end of each of your turns against ongoing mental effects.

Attempt a skill check with your connection skill against the Will DC of a foe you can see within 30 feet. The target is them temporarily immune for 1 hour. text: Your latest augmentation is a multifunction unit capable of processing metals of all types for a variety of purposes, a Metallic Augmentation Xtractor (MAX). You can use the benefits of the jury-rigging raxilite heritage once every 10 minutes, even if you don't have the heritage. If you have the heritage, you recover a number of Hit Points equal to seven times your level instead of five times your level.

name: Metaphysical Understanding
text: You can protect yourself against effects associated with the fundamental foundations of the cosmos. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to all saving throws against divine effects.

name: Method Actor
text: You like to live as the character you're playing, which makes your performances incredibly convincing. Whenever you would critically fail a Deception check to Impersonate, you fail instead.

name: Meyel's Melody
text: Divine rhythm pulses through your blood, and your life is the music. You gain a +2 status bonus to Performance checks. In addition, you can use Performance to [[/act create-a-diversion skill=performance]]{Create a Diversion}, [[/act demoralize skill=performance]]{Demoralize}, or [[/act make-an-impression skill=performance]]{Make an Impression}. If you listen to music while resting, you regain a number of additional Hit Points equal to your level.

name: Meyel's Tailspin
text: Requirements You're Prone. This technique allows you to use the momentum of your attack with the assistance of your tail to spin back onto your feet. Make a melee Strike with your claws or a battle ribbon, then Stand. You don't take the –2 circumstance penalty for attacking while prone, and your Stand action doesn't trigger reactions from the target of your Strike.

name: Mighty Guardian
text: The magical spark you use to protect others grows in power. You can cast Share Life and Status as 2nd-rank divine innate spells, once per day each.

name: Mighty Shoulders
text: Even among your kind, you possess a powerful build with broad shoulders and overlapping chitinous plates that makes your anatomy well suited to carrying heavy loads. Increase your maximum carried Bulk and the amount of Bulk you can carry before becoming encumbered by 2. When you're encumbered, reduce the penalty to your Speeds by 5 feet.

name: Mimic Defenses
text: You replicate a creature's innate resilience. When you assume the form of a creature you have studied for at least 1 minute, you gain resistance 3 to one damage type that creature possesses.

name: Mind over Matter
text: Your telekinetic capabilities extend beyond personal levitation, allowing you to handle nearby objects with precision. Your telekinesis grants you the equivalent of two additional hands, following the rules for characters with more than two hands as detailed in Starfinder Player Core. However, each of the telekinetic hands can wield only items of 1 Bulk or less. The Switch Hands action gains the contemplative trait when you switch to or from your telekinetic hands.

name: Mindrender
text: You've honed your thoughts into a deadly weapon that can shatter a foe's mind. You gain a psychic shock ranged unarmed attack with a range increment of 30 feet and the agile trait. The weapon deals 1d4 mental damage and is in the mental weapon group.

name: Mindward Shield
text: Your solar shield acts as an anchor for your mind as much as your body. When your Raise your solar Shield, you gain the shield's circumstance bonus to Will saves. In addition, while you have your solar shield raised, you can Shield Block when you take damage as a result of a failed Will save, in addition to its usual trigger. If you do, the triggering damage bypasses your solar shield's object immunities.

name: Mineral Shield
text: Your deep connection to the earth allows you to shape it to your own purposes, sometimes without even using your hands. You seek out particles of dust and stone around you and draw them to yourself, creating a calcified shield of stone around your limbs. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use. While the mineral shield is in effect, you can use the Shield Block reaction with your mineral shield and can use it to reduce damage only from effects that deal electricity or fire damage. This shield has Hardness 5, but if used underground or in a foundry or junkyard where scraps of metal are plentiful, the shield gains resistance 5 to electricity and fire. After you use Shield Block, the effect ends. Special You can improve your shield by applying shield improvements to a small stone trinket with negligible Bulk that you must be wearing when you use Mineral Shield.

name: Mirage
text: You can create illusory versions of yourself and channel your electricity through the mirage. You can cast Project Image once per day as an innate arcane spell. Whenever you cast project image, you can use your Dragon Breath from either your actual position or the image's position.

name: Mire Tracker
text: If you can track something in the stinking, shifting swamps of the Mire, it puts you in company with some of the finest trackers in the galaxy. You gain the Terrain Expertise feat for swamps and sewers, and you can [[/act track]] while moving at full Speed while you're in a swamp or sewer.

name: Mission Briefing
text: Coming prepared to mission briefings gives you extra time to ask questions and research a topic relevant to your next adventure. You are trained in Mission Lore, a special Lore skill that can be used only to Recall Knowledge, but on any topic related to an assignment, mission, or quest performed on behalf of another individual or organization. If you fail a check to Recall Knowledge with Mission Lore, you get the effects of the Dubious Knowledge skill feat unless the question was already answered during a mission briefing. If you have legendary proficiency in Society, you gain expert proficiency in Mission Lore, but you can't increase your proficiency rank in Mission Lore by any other means.

name: Mist Vision
text: You've altered your vision to see through various types of mist and vapor. You automatically succeed at the flat check to target a concealed creature if that creature is concealed only by clouds, fog, or mist. If you are a cloud dragon, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus on Perception checks and DCs to Seek creatures hidden or undetected using only a cloud, fog, or mist for concealment, or against Hide and Sneak actions by creatures hidden or undetected using only a cloud, fog, or mist for concealment.

name: Mobile Aim
text: You're rarely still, and you've learned to reliably hit your targets even while moving. You Stride and then Aim with a gun you're wielding.

name: Mobile Deployment
text: Two actions: you Stride twice, and at any point during this movement you can Deploy Mine or Deploy Turret.

name: Mobility
text: You can move easily through threatened areas. You gain a +4 bonus to AC against attacks of opportunity made against you when you move out of a threatened square.

name: Modify Drone
text: You can apply mods to your drone as if it were a weapon, applying their benefits to any weapon in its integrated weapon mount.

name: Molecular Modification
text: You modify your body's genetics to resist certain damage types. You gain resistance to acid, bludgeoning, cold, electricity, fire, piercing, poison, slashing, or sonic damage equal to half your level. Special You can take this feat multiple times. Each time you do so, select a different damage type.

name: Molting Metamorphosis
text: You've gained precise control over where and when your chitinous exoskeleton molts. You can spend a week of downtime to retrain any other ancestry feat. In addition, you can spend a week of downtime to permanently change your appearance. You retain a roughly similar height (within 6 inches) and weight (within 50 pounds), but your face shape, coloring, sex, and even distinctive mannerisms change to adapt to your new body type. Changing your appearance gives you a +4 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to prevent others from recognizing you. You can retrain your ancestry feat and change your appearance at the same time, even if you're using effects like Dreaming Potential.

name: Momentum
text: Requirements Your last action was a successful solar weapon Strike. You use the momentum of your last attack to maneuver around the battlefield, either by leaving photonic images or making great gravity-assisted leaps. Step twice. Graviton-Attuned You move 10 feet with each Step, rather than 5 feet. Photon-Attuned You leave an afterimage in the square you started in. This image lasts until the end of your next turn but ends early if another creature enters the space. This afterimage counts as an ally to you and your allies for the purposes of flanking.

text: As long as you and your bonded partner are on the same plane of existence and both alive, you can communicate telepathically together and both remain aware of one another's present state, general direction and distance from one another, and if they are conscious, Unconscious, or dying. You both know any conditions affecting one another, except those that the affected character does not know about.

name: Monster Crafting
text: You can use the parts of monsters to aid in crafting. You can use the body of a monster to help Craft items, using Survival instead of Crafting for the Craft activity when you do so. If parts of the monster's body are valuable, you can expend them toward the item's raw material cost as well. (The GM makes the determination if the monster's entry doesn't list any valuable materials from its body.) If you spend additional days working on the item, reduce the Price using the monster's level instead of your own. Certain items may require specific creatures in their Craft requirement.

name: Monstrous Frenzy
text: The more time you spend in combat, the more threats you see to your allies and the harder you work to protect your chosen family. Though it can be difficult to channel your fervor, you've found the strength to call upon it more and more. You can use Frenzy with a frequency of once per hour, rather than once per day. When you enter a frenzy, the status bonus to attack rolls also applies to damage, but the penalty to AC increases to –3.

name: Moodscales
text: Your scales automatically change color to match your current temperament. This has the same effect as a Moodskin augmentation, though it doesn't count as an augmentation and doesn't count toward your implant limit. When you select this feat, you can decide which colors correspond to each mood. Your keen awareness of your mood grants you a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against emotion effects. If you roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead.

name: Moonsilver
text: Your entire body is imbued with the power of the moon, and so your draconic unarmed attacks have great power over creatures affected by the lunar cycle. Your unarmed attacks from your dragon ancestry are treated as silver. This allows you to deal more damage to a variety of supernatural creatures, such as devils and werecreatures.

name: Mother Tongue
text: Your connection to the First World is strong. Whenever you meet a fey creature in a social situation, you can immediately attempt a Diplomacy check to [[/act make-an-impression]] on that creature rather than needing to converse for 1 minute. You take a –4 circumstance penalty to the check. If you fail, you can engage in 1 minute of conversation and attempt a new check at the end of that time rather than accepting the failure or critical failure result. In addition, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to both Perception checks and saving throws against fey.

name: Mount
text: You are proud to serve as a mount for your trusted allies. This might be a natural development, or it might be the result of intense training to ensure you can operate as a mount for your allies. When another PC rides you as a mount, your expert coordination allows them to gain three actions at the start of their turn rather than the two they normally would for riding another PC. You still gain only two actions at the start of your turn instead of three, however, as you spend the third action keeping your ally balanced on your back and ensuring they're firmly mounted.

name: Mounted Unity
text: Your ability to bear your bonded partner into battle has further improved, and you act as one body and one mind. When your bonded partner rides you as a mount, you gain three actions at the start of your turn, rather than the two you normally would.

name: Mournful Howl
text: Requirements You're within 30 feet of an ally with the dying condition. The sight of an ally near death overwhelms you with sorrow. In an act of frustration, you unleash a mournful, keening howl that forces your enemies to share in your heartbreak. You deal floor((@item.level - 1)/2)d6[mental|traits:nonlethal] nonlethal mental damage to all enemies in a type:emanation|distance:30 (will|against:class-spell|basic save using your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher). The damage increases by 1d6 for every two levels you have beyond 13th.

name: Moxie
text: You've never met a problem big enough to make you give up. Once per day as a reaction, when you would be demoralized by a Demoralize attempt, you can instead treat it as if the check had failed.

name: Muck Trawler
text: The thick murky waters of the Deepmarsh are navigable to those who understand their tricks. You ignore difficult terrain and uneven ground caused by swamps and sewers. You don't gain the Off-Guard condition for not having a swim Speed during aquatic combat. If you have a swim Speed, you ignore non-magical difficult terrain while swimming underwater, but not greater difficult terrain.

name: Multi-Armed Grab
text: Requirements You have a creature grappled or Restrained using one or more active limbs. You use all of your available limbs to hold on tight. You use your second pair of arms to hold on to the Grabbed or restrained target. If you're in quadrupedal posture, you automatically Change Posture to bipedal as part of this action. The grabbed creature takes a –2 circumstance penalty to Escape being grabbed by you until the end of your next turn.

name: Multi-Armed Specialist
text: Your four arms allow you to wield multiple weapons with ease. You can hold weapons or equipment in all four hands and do not take a penalty to attacks made with your non-primary hands.

name: Multi-Legged Copaxi
text: You've grown more legs than a typical copaxi, or your legs are especially long, increasing the length of your strides. Your Speed increases by 5 feet.

name: Multi-Stemmed
text: Your body has two primary "trunks," one of which has diverged in nature from the other. Choose one khizar heritage that you don't already have; you gain that heritage and its benefits.

name: Multidisciplinary Mechanic
text: Choose biotech, magitech, or necrotech. You become trained in the associated skill (Nature, Arcana, or Religion) and gain Additional Lore in its lore. Magitech also gives your exocortex's Strikes the magic trait. This sets the damage type for your Critical Explosion / Explosive Shot, if you have them.

name: Multilingual
text: You have a gift for languages. You learn two new languages of your choice, plus an additional language each time you increase your Society proficiency.

name: Multitalented
text: You've learned to split your focus between multiple classes with ease. You gain a 2nd-level multiclass dedication feat, even if you normally couldn't take another dedication feat until you take more feats from your current archetype.

name: Multitasker
text: You're permanently quickened, and can use your extra action to Command your drone, fire your turret, or Detonate Mine.

name: Multiverse Magic
text: Your paradoxical nature has given you access to magic that isn't associated with your spellcasting tradition. You can have one spell in your spell repertoire (not one on your paradox's spell list) that isn't from your spellcasting tradition. Select this spell when you select this feat. You can cast that spell as a spell of your spellcasting tradition, and it becomes a signature spell. You can change the spell you choose when you gain a level.

name: Multivision
text: Your extra eyes eliminate blind spots in your perception. You cannot be flanked, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks.

name: Mutable Manifestation

name: Nanite Arena
text:
The nanites in your synthetic cortex surge outward, dynamically connecting to one another to form a network of hardlight plates for 1 minute or until you use an Interact action to return all the nanites into your body. While the nanites are out in this way, you have the following characteristics.
As a 1-action activity, you can create a 1-foot thick, 5-foot long wall of hardlight in a point you can see within 30 feet. The wall has AC 10, Hardness 30, and 70 Hit Points, and it's immune to critical hits and precision damage. The wall blocks physical effects from passing through it but doesn't block line of sight.
You can use your senses as if you were in the position of any of these walls.
If a creature is adjacent to one of the hardlight walls while moving, it can spend 5 feet of movement to teleport to a square adjacent to any of the other hardlight walls.
While at least one hardlight wall is out, and if you're adjacent to a hardlight wall or it's between you and your attacker, you can use Shield Block as if you had a shield raised, using the hardlight wall's Hardness and Hit Points. The wall disappears after the reaction is used.

name: Nanite Armament Boost
text:
Requirements You're wielding a weapon.
You pour your nanites into your weapon, empowering its next attacks. The weapon deals electricity damage instead of its normal damage type, and it gains the boost 1d4 trait until the end of your next turn.

name: Nanite Armament Efficiency
text: You manipulate your nanites more efficiently. When you use Nanite Armament Boost, you also take the Boost action.

name: Nanite Armament Overcharge
text: You gain even greater control over your nanites when using them to power up your weapons. When you use Nanite Armament Boost, your weapon gains the boost d8 trait instead of boost d4.

name: Nanite Communication
text: Your nanites can reshape your synthetic cortex to enable you to communicate mentally with creatures within 30 feet. You can communicate only with creatures that share a language with you. This doesn't give you any access to their thoughts, and it communicates no more information than normal speech would.

name: Nanite Form
text: Frequency once per day You change into a swarm of nanites for up to 1 minute or until you spend a single action to return to your normal shape. You become Huge, gain the swarm trait, and gain a fly Speed of 40 feet. As a swarm, you have the following characteristics. You're immune to the Grabbed, Prone, and Restrained conditions. You have weakness 5 to area and splash damage. You can occupy the same space as other creatures and must do so to use your damaging ability. As a 2-action activity, you can deal 10d6 acid damage to all creatures sharing your space (basic Reflex save with a DC equal to your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher). You can't speak, Cast Spells, use manipulate actions requiring your hands, Activate magic items, or make any Strikes with your normal body. You don't gain the swarm mind ability, so you're still affected normally by mental effects.

name: Nanite Hardlight Construction
text: You can use your nanites and their hardlight projectors to form hardlight gear. You can cast Creation as a 5th-rank arcane innate spell once per day. The item you create is a hardlight projection and has no monetary value; it also doesn't need to be made of earthen or plant-derived matter. It can't replicate a specific item, such as the key card to a specific lock, unless you have intricate knowledge of what the specific item looks like and how it works, such as knowing the data that needs to be on the keycard for it to open the lock. It otherwise functions as a mundane item of its kind until your next daily preparations, though it vanishes if you move more than 100 feet away from it.

name: Nanite Repair
text: Frequency once per hour You can use your nanites to repair objects. You touch a common tech item with a level up to your level with the Broken or Glitching condition. It loses the broken condition until the end of your turn, allowing you to use the item as normal. You also reduce the glitching value of the item you touch by 1.

name: Nanite Scream
text: The nanites in your synthetic cortex not only enable you to mentally communicate with others, but you can also mentally attack your enemies. You can cast Share Pain and Void Whispers as 3rd-rank arcane innate spells once per day each.

name: Nanite Shield
text: Your nanites form into a network of hardlight projectors to create a protective barrier. You can cast the Shield cantrip as an arcane innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. When you use the Shield Block reaction granted by the spell, your nanites surge back into your body, allowing you to Step as part of the same reaction.

name: Nanite Strangulation
text: The nanites in your synthetic cortex enable you to psychically reach out and grasp a vital part of a creature's anatomy and lift them. Once per day, you can cast Telekinetic Strangulation as a 6th-rank arcane innate spell.

name: Nanite Surge
text: Once per day, you can trigger a nanite surge as a reaction to gain a +2 circumstance bonus to any one d20 roll.

name: Nanite Tantrum
text: The nanites in your cortex are supercharged, enabling you to hurl objects in your environment. Once per day, you can cast Telekinetic Tantrum as a 9th-rank arcane innate spell.

name: Nanite Tool
text: Frequency once per day You can use your nanites to create the perfect tool for a job. Outside of combat, you can have your nanites form a toolkit of a level no higher than half your level (minimum 0). The item lasts for 1 minute. Because your nanites must be actively working to provide the tool, you can't use other feats that require the use of your nanites while you're using them as a tool.

name: Natural Born Speedster
text: You've lived your life chasing the thrill of high speeds, so driving fast vehicles was a natural fit. You become trained in Piloting. If you are already trained in Piloting, you become trained in a Lore skill related to vehicles, such as Gambling Lore, Starship Lore, Travel Lore, or Vehicle Lore. You gain the Express Driver skill feat.

name: Natural Camouflage
text: Your scales blend in with the rocks and rubble of your home world. While you're outdoors on Akiton or a similar planet, and you're in a desert, mountain, or plains terrain, you don't need cover to Hide or Sneak from creatures at least 10 feet away from you.

name: Natural Empathy
text: You have an empathic understanding of nature and can use your limited telepathy to communicate with plants and fungi, even if you don't share a common language. You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with plants and fungi. In most cases, wild plants and fungi will give you time to make your case. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your checks to Make an Impression on plants and fungi.

name: Natural Grace
text: Frequency once per day Trigger You fail an Acrobatics check or Reflex saving throw. You have an almost supernatural control of your movements, which can sometimes save you in dangerous situations. You can reroll the triggering skill check or saving throw, using the second result even if it's worse.

name: Natural Hunter
text: You have the keen instincts of a hunter and know to go for the throat. If you're a sharp-toothed vlaka, the damage you deal with your jaws increases to 1d8, and your jaws lose the finesse trait and gain the grapple trait. Otherwise, you gain a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d4 piercing damage. Your jaws are in the brawling group and have the finesse and unarmed traits. In either case, whenever you score a critical hit with your jaws unarmed attack, your target takes 1 persistent bleed damage per weapon damage die, in addition to the other effects of a critical hit.

name: Natural Medicine
text: You treat wounds using natural remedies. You can use Nature instead of Medicine to Treat Wounds, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus when working in a natural environment.

name: Nauseating Presence
text:
Frequency once per day

You surround yourself with alien corruption that sickens those nearby. For 1 minute, you gain a nauseating presence aura in a 20-foot emanation around you. Enemies who enter the aura (or are in the aura when you activate it) must attempt a Will save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC with the following results. Afterwards, they are temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected by the presence.

Success The taint of the void corrupts those within your presence, weakening them against sickness. The creature takes a –2 circumstance penalty to saving throws against diseases and saving throws to reduce the sickened condition while within the aura.

Effect: Nauseating Presence

Failure As success, except the creature is also Sickened 1.

Critical Failure As success, except the creature is also Sickened 2.

name: Necrogourmand
text: Whether through atonement, supernatural evolution, or mutation, your internal organs have regrown and reconnected to your soul in such a way that you can gain pleasure from eating and drinking once again, giving you a flushed, healthy appearance. This gives you a +1 status bonus on checks to appear as a non-undead creature. You can also now receive healing from items with the vitality trait that are eaten, ingested, absorbed, or injected (such as serums or oils), but you only receive half the normal amount of healing (rounded up).

name: Necrotized
text: You became a borai intentionally through necromantic experimentation conducted by yourself or someone else before you died. This experimentation has strengthened your defenses against death but has also made you look more like a corpse than a living being. You gain the Diehard feat, and death effects no longer kill you if they reduce you to 0 Hit Points. This keeps you from being automatically killed or from having your dying value automatically decrease, but it doesn't make you immune to other parts of the spell or effect. For example, you can still take mental damage and become frightened by a vision of death spell, you just don't instantly die from it.

name: Need For Speed
text: Frequency once per day You're always spinning your wheel, and you can strain your body and mind to push yourself beyond your normal limits. You become Quickened for 4 rounds. You can use the extra action each round only to Stride.

name: Negotiator
text: You drive a hard bargain. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks made during negotiations involving trade, payment, or favors.

name: Network Attunement
text: Target any number of your bonded allies within 120 feet Feeling the surge of your strong communal bond, you temporarily attune your vitality network to the spiritual wavelength of your allies. Each ally can immediately choose to transfer up to 20 Hit Points from your vitality network into themselves or up to 20 Hit Points from themselves into the vitality network.

name: Network Attunement
text:
Target any number of your bonded allies within 120 feet

Feeling the surge of your strong communal bond, you temporarily attune your vitality network to the spiritual wavelength of your allies. Each ally can immediately choose to transfer up to 20 Hit Points from your vitality network into themselves or up to 20 Hit Points from themselves into the vitality network.

name: Network Expansion
text: Your mycelial network reaches farther. Your tremorsense increases to 60 feet and you can share information with willing creatures whose feet touch the same surface as you.

name: Network of Know-How
text: Your synthetic brain is able to absorb a massive amount of practical knowledge, granting you the ability to accomplish various tasks you aren't specialized in. You gain the Untrained Improvisation general feat. In addition, you can attempt skill actions that normally require you to be an expert, even if you're only untrained or trained.

name: Network Shield
text: Trigger You're hit by an attack. You condense the energy of your vitality network into a shield. The triggering attack reduces your vitality network's Hit Points instead of your own, up to twice your level. Any remaining damage after your Vitality Network is reduced to 0 Hit Points is dealt to you instead.

name: Network Shield
text:
Trigger You're hit by an attack.

You condense the energy of your vitality network into a shield. The triggering attack reduces your vitality network's Hit Points instead of your own, up to twice your level. Any remaining damage after your Vitality Network is reduced to 0 Hit Points is dealt to you instead.

name: Never Again
text: Trigger You're about to gain the Confused or Controlled condition. You refuse to surrender your autonomy ever again, and you've trained your mind to instinctively shake off mental control. Attempt a flat. On a success, you don't gain the triggering condition.

name: Never the Sucker
text: Others might be victims of ill omens or portents of doom, but you can shrug off even the darkest of tidings. Your luck might have faltered temporarily, leaving you in a precarious spot, but you can always trust it to help you set things right. When you would reduce the doomed condition by 1, reduce it by 2 instead. You also gain the Game Face reaction.

name: New Epiphany
text: Through dedication or serendipity, you've branched out to explore other connections to the fundamental building blocks of the cosmos. You learn the initial epiphany spell of a connection that grants training in the prerequisite connection skill.

name: New Epiphany
text: Through dedication or serendipity, you've branched out to explore other connections to the fundamental building blocks of the cosmos. You learn the initial epiphany spell of a connection that grants training in the prerequisite connection skill.

name: New Path
text: Frequency once per day With a short moment of introspection, you can reposition yourself within the maze of life to find a new vocation. You can spend 10 minutes to Retrain the Lore skill you chose with Maze Lost to a different subcategory.

name: Newborn Incarnate
text: You conjure forth a visage of the psychic imprint from the Newborn that imbues your heritage. You can cast Mask of Terror as a 7th-rank occult innate spell once per day.

name: Nictitating Membrane
text: Requirements You are Blinded or Dazzled with a duration of 1 minute or less. You have a well-developed nictitating membrane, which you use to see underwater and clear out obstructions. If you are dazzled due to an effect other than Nictitating Membrane, reduce the flat check DC to target a creature with concealment caused by your dazzled condition from 5 to 3 until the end of your next turn. If you are blinded, attempt a flat. On a success, you remove the blinded condition and gain the dazzled condition instead for the same duration as the blinded condition. You cannot use this to remove a permanent blinded condition.

name: Night Eyes
text: Whether from hunting at night or having a deep connection to the void of space, you're at home in darkness. You become trained in Stealth. You gain the Terrain Stalker skill feat, except instead of selecting a form of difficult terrain, you can use the feat in areas of dim light and darkness.

name: Nimble Crawl
text: You can Crawl incredibly swiftly—up to half your Speed, rather than 5 feet. If you're a master in Acrobatics, you can Crawl at full Speed, and if you're legendary, you aren't Off-Guard while Prone.

name: Nimble Elf
text: Your reflexes are quick. Your Speed increases by 5 feet.

name: Nimble Runner
text: Few places are as hazardous to run through as the scrublands of Marata, and few people spend as much of their time running as young maraquois. You've gained an otherworldly expertise in placing your feet just right to rush over even the roughest ground. When you Stride, ignore the first 10 feet of non-magical difficult terrain, or treat 10 feet of non-magical greater difficult terrain as difficult terrain.

name: Nimble Striker
text: Your feline agility makes you exceptionally hard to hit while moving. You don't trigger reactions when you move, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn after Striding.

name: Nimble Tail
text: You have an incredibly nimble tail that helps you balance in zero gravity; this could be a hereditary gift from your ancestors as they adapted to spaceflight or the result of personal augmentation. You can use your tail to Push Off while in zero-g without needing a free hand. In addition, you ignore the clumsy and Off-Guard penalties while Untethered in zero gravity.

name: Nimbus Block
text: You've combined the strength of your defensive powers such that your solar nimbus bolsters your solar shield. When you Shield Block a melee attack with your solar shield, as long as either you or your shield take damage from the attack, you can use Nimbus Ward as a free action.

name: Nimbus Block
text: You've combined the strength of your defensive powers such that your solar nimbus bolsters your solar shield. When you Shield Block a melee attack with your solar shield, as long as either you or your shield take damage from the attack, you can use Nimbus Ward as a free action.

name: Nimbus Ward
text: Trigger You would be damage by an attack, spell, or other effect. Requirements You're aware of the triggering effect and not offguard. You harness your solar nimbus to protect yourself from harm. You gain resistance equal to half your level (rounded up) until the start of your next turn. You choose the type of resistance when you use this action, depending on your current attunement. You can use Nimbus Ward as a reaction only when the requirements and trigger are met, but you can use it as a 1-action activity without the requirements or trigger being met. Graviton-Attuned Your resistance can be one of the following types of damage: bludgeoning, force, piercing, or slashing. Photon-Attuned Your resistance can be one of the following types of energy damage: acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic.
