name: No Cause for Alarm
text: You can talk down panicking creatures with a soothing word. As a single action you can attempt a Diplomacy check to reduce the frightened condition of an ally within 60 feet by 1.

name: No Memory Left Behind
text: By honoring the memories of each of your amalgamated souls, you've learned how to better learn from their experiences. You can use Memories of Valor once per hour instead of once per day.

name: No! My Baubles!
text: You carry so many trinkets around with you that you're only a little heartbroken when they shatter. You can use Treasure on My Heart once per hour instead of once per day.

name: Nomad's Guard
text: You have learned a technique practiced by shobhad boxers and warriors to fend off strikes from fists and blades. As long as you have at least one free hand (including an inactive hand), your fist unarmed attack gains the parry trait.

name: Nomad's Persistence
text: Shobhad-neh survive in conditions that would grind other species to exhaustion. When you would become Fatigued, attempt a flat|dc:17. On a success, you aren't fatigued. If the fatigued condition has an underlying cause that you don't address, such as a lack of rest, you must attempt this check again at an interval determined by the GM until you fail the check or address the underlying cause.

name: Nondescript Features
text: People and machines both struggle to discern your features, making you difficult to keep track of in a crowd. You become trained in Society (or another skill of your choice if you're already trained) and gain the Blend In skill feat.

name: Nonlethal Force
text: You avoid harm when you can help it. During your daily preparations, you can designate a weapon on your person. It gains the nonlethal trait while you wield it. If you designate a new weapon during daily preparations, the previously designated weapon loses the nonlethal trait.

name: Nonlethal Spell
text: You can alter offensive spells to be less deadly. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that deals damage and doesn't have the death or void trait, that spell gains the nonlethal trait.

name: Nonlethal Spell (Peacekeeper)
text: You can alter offensive spells to be less deadly. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that deals damage and doesn't have the death or void trait, that spell gains the nonlethal trait.

name: Nonlethal Spell (Starfinder)
text: You can alter offensive spells to be less deadly. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that deals damage and doesn't have the death or void trait, that spell gains the nonlethal trait.

name: Nonnegotiable Command
text: Frequency once per 10 minutes You bark a simple command to spur your allies to action. Select Stride, Strike, or Step. Your allies who can perceive your command can use their reaction to take the action you selected. This action gains the auditory trait if you shout, but not if you use telepathy.

name: Nonthreatening Visage
text: Let's face it—you're not scaring anyone; many find something inherently disarming about small, low-slung, cheerful talphis, and you're prepared to take full advantage of it. You gain the Charming Liar skill feat as a bonus feat. Additionally, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Deception checks for initiative.

name: Nostalgia For Worlds Lost
text: You miss your home world of Aucturn, and even if you don't want to go back to your time there, the thought of its strange vistas fills your heart with fond memories. If you would critically fail a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a failure instead. In addition, you gain the Thoughts of a Lost Home action.

name: Not As Bad As It Looked
text: Frequency twice per day Trigger You or an ally you can see within 15 feet rolls a critical failure on a saving throw or skill check. Even when you or your ally's luck seems to run out, it's not as bad as it seems. The triggering critical failure becomes a failure instead.

name: Not Falling for That
text: Frequency: once per day Trigger: You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not immediately killed. This isn't your last limdive. You avoid being knocked out and remain at 1 Hit Point, and your wounded condition increases by 1. For the next minute, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your AC and a +5-foot status bonus to your Speed.

name: Not in the Face
text: Trigger A creature targets you with a melee attack. You wave your arms to shield your face from harm and cower, acting meek and pitiful. Attempt a deception|against:will check against the triggering creature's Will DC. The triggering creature is then immune to Not in the Face for 1 hour. Critical Success Your attacker has second thoughts about harming you and is thoroughly thrown off. It takes a –2 status penalty to attack and damage rolls against you until the start of its next turn. Success Your attacker is thrown off. It takes a –1 status penalty to attack rolls against you until the start of its next turn. Failure Your attacker is temporarily thrown off. It takes a –1 circumstance penalty to the triggering attack roll. Critical Failure Your attacker is unaffected.

name: Not in the Face
text:
Trigger A creature targets you with a melee attack.

You wave your arms to shield your face from harm and cower, acting meek and pitiful. Attempt a check against the triggering creature's Will DC. The triggering creature is then immune to Not in the Face for 1 hour.

Critical Success Your attacker has second thoughts about harming you and is thoroughly thrown off. It takes a –2 status penalty to attack and damage rolls against you until the start of its next turn.

Success Your attacker is thrown off. It takes a –1 status penalty to attack rolls against you until the start of its next turn.

Failure Your attacker is temporarily thrown off. It takes a –1 status penalty to the triggering attack roll.

Critical Failure Your attacker is unaffected.

name: Not So Vestigial
text: You've trained your vestigial limbs for combat, and once you have control of an enemy with your larger and more powerful limbs, the smaller, sneakier ones go to work. You're permanently Quickened. You can this extra action only to [[/act disarm]], grab, or [[/act trip]] a creature.

name: Novel Mutation
text:
You present evolutions distinct from any other members of your species, like your ancestors developed for an environment different than your peers, but no records indicate how or what happened to necessitate your variance. Genetic or temporal attempts to trace your family history or lineage find nothing.

You gain one 1st-level ancestry feat you qualify for from an ancestry different from yours. That ancestry feat has the Gap-touched trait for you.

name: Novice Necrovite
text: Your studies as a necrovite have progressed, and you've learned how to influence mindless undead. You can use Diplomacy to [[/act make-an-impression]] on mindless undead or [[/act request]] simple tasks of them. If the undead creature is controlled by a creature with a higher level than yours, you typically need a critical success on your Diplomacy skill check.

name: Noxious Secretion
text: Your body exudes a contact poison. Creatures that successfully Grapple you or are grappled by you take 1d4 poison damage per round (Fortitude DC = 10 + level + CON modifier negates).
